author: Dale Philip
description: I visited Kota Tua, the old town of Jakarta. Inside the old Dutch post office building is now an Indonesia food court, where enjoyed this staple of Indonesian cuisine. Gado-gado is an Indonesian salad with a bunch of healthy vegetables, boiled egg, boiled potato, tofu, tempeh, and lontong, all covered in a delicious a peanut sauce dressing. Yum yum!
title: Gado-Gado Indonesian Salad in Jakarta 🇮🇩
